# Novalyn

> Novalyn is a Chrome extension that relists a Vinted seller's own listings in bulk.
> It publishes the copy first, archives the original, and only then deletes the old
> ad — the reverse of the delete-first approach most relisting tools use.

Novalyn is an independent tool for sellers. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by
or sponsored by Vinted.

## What it is

- A Chrome extension (Manifest V3), installed from the Chrome Web Store:
  https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/novalyn-%E2%80%94-vinted-relister/flnfapmkkmegfpbakndnlgehimpfccic
- Works on 29 Vinted marketplaces, and shows amounts in each market's own currency.
- Runs in the tab the seller is already signed in to: no account, no password, no
  separate login.
- Relists one ad at a time with a pause between items, keeps to the seller's own
  hourly and daily limits, and stops on a verification challenge, an HTTP 429 or a
  Vinted restriction instead of retrying into it.
- Imports the listings from the seller's own wardrobe, and refuses any page that is
  not the wardrobe of the account that is signed in.
- Also provides: per-ad results (views per day before and after a relist), a private
  sales-and-costs ledger with CSV import/export, scheduled relisting that waits for
  approval, an archive of every original with a full API backup, and a bulk price
  list to paste into Vinted.

## What it does not do

- It does not promise more views. A relist is a new ad, so it starts from zero views
  and favourites; whether that helps depends on the ad, the photos and the price.
  Novalyn measures the before/after rate so the seller can judge it on their own ads.
- It is not a Vinted feature, and it is not a bot farm: it drives the seller's own
  signed-in session at a human pace.
- The shipped build does not edit prices through Vinted's API. It produces a price
  list instead, because a price change requires re-sending the whole advert.
- It does not collect telemetry, and it has no server that sees the seller's data.

## Facts

- Free tier: 50 successful relists per install, then 20 relists per rolling 30 days.
  Neither is reset by clearing history; both are mirrored to Chrome sync.
- Pricing: €4 per month, €40 per year, or €80 once (lifetime). Prices include VAT.
  Payment and cards are handled by Stripe; the licence key is emailed automatically.
- Requirements: desktop Chrome, a signed-in Vinted account, and the seller's own ads.
- Data: listings, history, archive, records and settings live in the browser's local
  storage. No account, no analytics, no telemetry.
- Privacy policy: https://novalyn-app.github.io/privacy.html
- Refund policy (14 days): https://novalyn-app.github.io/refund.html
